protocol: Frozen model comparison. No RPM, temperature, cooling or map parameters are refitted. Limits test compatibility; nominal/exhibit and earlier-variant references are qualified comparisons, not matched empirical validation. Thrust is an input for the hot-temperature comparison, not a validation output.

sources.title: FAA TCDS E3NE, revision 16, 25 July 2019
sources.kind: certified maximum speeds and total exhaust-gas temperature, historical revision; not measured operating points
sources.notes: Standard -7R4D and -7R4D1 variants. The note separately identifies converted (DM)/(EM) engines with 3810/8080 rpm limits; the grouped ICAO entry does not identify a conversion.

sources.title: Osaka Metropolitan University Archives Newsletter No.14, JT9D-7R4D exhibit
sources.locator: PDF p.3, Figure 2, exhibit specification panel
sources.kind: published exhibit specifications for JAL-donated -7R4D; not an instrumented test dataset
sources.notes: Panel concerns engine P717001. Hot temperatures specify 48000 lbf / 213.5 kN at 92 F (33.3 C). Use printed SI temperature 33.3 C. Installed 208.0 kN includes a stated 2.3% nacelle loss and is not substituted for uninstalled thrust. Idle RPM lacks fuel, ambient, bleed and uncertainty metadata.

sources.title: NASA/Pratt & Whitney Experimental Clean Combustor Program: Engine Test Results
sources.locator: Table V-3, printed p.111 / PDF p.21; standard-day JT9D-7A generator reference conditions
sources.kind: earlier-variant reference cycle; not a matched -7R4D test dataset
sources.notes: Source calls combustor inlet Tt4; maps to this solver station 3, not station 4. Fuel is transcribed from kg/h and divided by 3600. Pressure is transcribed from the SI column (all rows x1e5 Pa). The takeoff psia entry (323) is inconsistent with the SI column (21.68e5 Pa); retain that discrepancy. Source precision and measurement uncertainty are not supplied.

rpmReferences.notes: 100% gauge RPM is a normalization reference, not a takeoff measurement or maximum. Ground/flight idle are nominal settings without a complete operating condition.

hotCase.stationMapping: Provisional: combustor outlet -> solver 4; turbine inlet -> solver 41 after first cooling mix. Probe location, traverse averaging and cooling definition are not supplied.
